messages:
olivia: Quick heads-up — cut window is today 21:00 UTC. Plan is to create release/2026.04.0 at that time. Please confirm: who can own branch creation + post-cut quick smoke? Also we need any outstanding changelog entries by 18:00 UTC and final backport PRs opened against release/2026.04.0 by 19:30 UTC.

matt: I can do the branch creation and initial tag, happy to take smoke as well if no objections.

sara: Quick q on backports: are we still limiting patch backports to bugfix/security only? we've got a small perf tweak that'd be nice in this cut.

kevin: Yes — rule hasn't changed. Features go to next minor. Perf tweak needs to be evaluated: if it changes behavior or API it goes to minor, otherwise maybe we can hotfix. Add justification in PR description.

jess: FYI flaky integration test (auth-flow) is failing intermittently on the main branch. I'm triaging but it might block merging late. I'll open a draft PR to skip the refactor test if needed.

olivia: thanks. Matt — when you create branch, please use the conventional name release/2026.04.0 and include this in the release metadata: version=2026.4.0; notes-team=platform; changelog-reviewer=@sara.

matt: Will do. Command I'll run:

```
# create branch from main
git fetch origin main
git checkout -b release/2026.04.0 origin/main
git push origin release/2026.04.0
```

matt: Also will create a tracking issue and assign owners for slices (infra/runtime/cli).

release-coordinator: Checklist reminder: [branch creation] -> create release/* at cutoff, add CHANGELOG.md header for the release, create release issue, set milestone, and post notif to #eng-releases. See release playbook: https://internal.redwood/release-playbook

olivia: For changelog entries: please follow the single-line format: component: short description (#PR). Example: runtime: reduce kv cache memory growth (PR #4891). Put in changelog/entries/2026.04.0/*.md or add to the release issue if you can't push a file.

kevin: Quick owner pins: infra slice = @kevin, runtime slice = @sara, cli slice = @jess. Ping me for infra backports.

matt: Opening the branch now (pre-cut) to let people start backporting PRs against it. I'll mark it protected and add required CI.

devops-bot: branch release/2026.04.0 created by matt at 2026-03-17T20:45:12Z. Protection: enabled. Required checks: ci/build, ci/integration.

olivia: Nice. Two reminders: 1) reopen PRs that were merged to main with fixes and retarget them to the release branch for backport review, 2) label backport PRs with "backport/2026.04.0".

jess: re: changelog — I've added my CLI entry in the release issue. PR #4922 is ready as backport candidate, targeting release/2026.04.0 now.

matt: Noted PR #4922. Please make sure the PR description includes: original PR link, reason for backport, risk assessment, and test plan.

olivia: If any PRs need an exception to the backport rule (e.g., small feature with low risk), add a one-line justification and @olivia + @kevin to the PR for a speedy exception review.

sara: One more — can we freeze non-critical merges after 20:30 UTC to give CI time? Recommend freeze at 20:30 and full lock at 21:00 until smoke passes.

kevin: Agree. I'll enforce the freeze and handle hotfix merges if approved by @olivia.

matt: I'll post a final reminder at 19:00 UTC listing open backport PRs and changelog status.

olivia: Perfect. thanks all — let's keep comments short in the release issue so reviewers can triage quickly. :thumbsup:

devops-bot: scheduled notification: final backport digest will be posted by matt at 19:00 UTC.
